script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: Hello, Riverside University Climbing Club, Hannah speaking.

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Oh, hi. I saw your poster in the library, and I was wondering if I could join the club this term.

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: Of course, we're always happy to have new members. I'll just fill in a membership form for you. Can I start with your name?

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Sure. It's Daniel Okafor. That's O-K-A-F-O-R.

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: Thanks, Daniel. And are you an undergraduate?

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: No, I'm actually a postgraduate. I started a master's in geography in September. I did economics for my first degree, but that was somewhere else.

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: Lovely. Could I have your student number as well?

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Yes, it's S, then four, seven, two, nine, one, five. Oh, hang on, sorry. The last number's an eight, not a five. So it's S-4-7-2-9-1-8.

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: No problem. Have you done any climbing before?

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: A bit. I've been going to an indoor wall for about two years, but I've never climbed outdoors on real rock.

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: That's a good start. Now, about the fee. Membership is normally forty-five pounds a year, but postgraduates pay a reduced rate of thirty.

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Oh, that's better than I expected. And when do you meet?

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: We use the wall at the sports centre twice a week, on Mondays and Thursdays. Mondays are really aimed at complete beginners, so with your experience you'd probably prefer Thursdays, from six till eight.

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Thursday suits me fine. Do I need to bring my own equipment?

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: The club lends out harnesses and ropes, so don't worry about those. But you'll need your own climbing shoes, because we can't share those for hygiene reasons.

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Right, I've got a pair already. What about outdoor trips? The poster mentioned them.

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: Yes, once a month we go out to the cliffs. We usually go to Harrow Point, but this term we're going to Stonebeck Quarry instead, because Harrow Point is closed while birds are nesting there.

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Makes sense. And is there anything I need to do before I can go on a trip?

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: Everyone has to attend our outdoor safety course first. It's just one evening and it's free. You don't have to pass a test or anything, you just need to be there.

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Great. I'll sign up for that, then. Is there anything else I should know?

script.speaker: Hannah
script.text: Just that the minibus for trips costs eight pounds each, and you'll need to bring your own lunch. I'll email you the form now so you can check the details.

script.speaker: Daniel
script.text: Perfect. Thanks so much for your help, Hannah.
